_doc: The Effects panel's Optimisations tab (game/settings/optimizations.gd): each option chosen alone, live, to measure what it gains and what it costs the picture. Its first value is the game as it draws (tier: the tier's own). field: the tier's field it sets (data/game/settings.json tiers); divide: the building reach is divided by the value. Three.js's own options have no counterpart here: the opaque sort and shader precision are the engine's, frustum culling is always on, shadow and relief passes every N frames do not exist in Godot's renderer.
